name: Gradaly v3.0.0
title: Gradaly v3.0.0
notes:
## What's New in Gradaly v3.0.0

- **Collaborative Project Sharing & Selective Per-Question Merge (Gradaly Pro)**: Share your exam projects with colleagues or teaching assistants via local `.gradaly` archives or **End-to-End Encrypted Cloud Links** (`AES-256-GCM` client-side encryption with zero-knowledge `#k=...` key fragment and chunked upload progress bar).
- **Safe Import & Question-by-Question Merge (Gradaly Pro)**: Import shared archives as a brand-new project under a custom name (100% conflict-free) or selectively merge rubrics and/or gradings question-by-question with SHA-256 canvas verification, conflict resolution rules, and automatic pre-merge backups.
- **Interactive Bilingual User Manual**: Added a complete step-by-step User Manual (EN/FR) on the website covering API key creation (OpenRouter, Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic), recommended models, collaborative workflows, and Zero-Knowledge security FAQ.
